where.if: AND (driver_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR vehicle_no LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR note ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

mapper.sql: id, missed_on, route_no, vehicle_no, trip_label, driver_name, missed_count, reason, note, created_by
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM hd_missed_trip
ORDER BY missed_on DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(missed_count), 0) AS missed_sum FROM hd_missed_trip

SELECT FROM hd_missed_trip
ORDER BY missed_on, id
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hd_route WHERE route_no = #{routeNo})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hd_missed_trip (missed_on, route_no, vehicle_no, trip_label, driver_name, missed_count, reason, note, created_by) VALUES (#{v.missedOn}, #{v.routeNo}, #{v.vehicleNo}, #{v.tripLabel}, #{v.driverName}, #{v.missedCount}, #{v.reason}, #{v.note}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE hd_missed_trip SET missed_on = #{v.missedOn}, route_no = #{v.routeNo}, vehicle_no = #{v.vehicleNo}, trip_label = #{v.tripLabel}, driver_name = #{v.driverName}, missed_count = #{v.missedCount}, reason = #{v.reason}, note = #{v.note}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
